subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should RFC 0009 freeze these catalog, account-feed, and signed-envelope shapes before the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub implementation PRs have landed?
rationale: The patch establishes a cross-project interoperability and trust contract; only maintainers can decide whether the open implementation branches are authoritative enough for last-call specification text.

options.title: Approve Joint Last Call
options.body: Keep the PR open and merge only after relevant OpenClaw and ClawHub owners explicitly approve the same wire and trust contract.

options.title: Wait For Implementations
options.body: Defer the normative rewrite until both linked implementation PRs land and their final schemas can be cited from main.

options.title: Merge Stable Subset
options.body: Narrow the PR to already-merged behavior and leave feed-id binding and account-feed clauses explicitly provisional.

recommendation.title: Approve Joint Last Call
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and merge only after relevant OpenClaw and ClawHub owners explicitly approve the same wire and trust contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest cross-repository implementation and RFC history and can coordinate the required owner approvals, although final acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
